batch_policy: B01-B08 partition the sink candidate rows by channel/family (each row examined once); B09-B12 partition the source candidate rows by input-boundary family; every CSV row is assigned to exactly one semantic group and every group to exactly one batch; groups are keyed by (channel family, callable role, flow kind, provenance); row counts, distinct-file counts and sample locations are recorded per group

coverage.dedup_policy: one labels.json entry per semantic API signature/group; every CSV row is assigned to exactly one group; groups are keyed by (channel family, callable, flow kind, provenance); row counts, distinct-file counts and sample locations are recorded per group; multi-entry groups split rows by sub-rule (G-P01 by request field, G-S08/G-S09 by callable/receiver)
coverage.exclusion_policy: rows are never dropped: 'none'/fp labels keep the audit trail; name-collision rows (session.query ORM vs SqlaTable.query, non-SQL f-strings in importers/benchmark script, sqlparse.format reformatting, tag-name f-string bound values) are explicitly labeled rather than silently excluded
